vibe: Cinematic, moody, arcane tabletop RPG overlay for OBS stream

layout_and_spacing.main_menu: absolute top-4 left-4 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2 w-64
layout_and_spacing.dice_rollers: absolute bottom-4 left-4 z-50 flex flex-col gap-4 w-72
layout_and_spacing.roll_history: absolute right-4 top-4 bottom-4 z-50 w-64 flex flex-col gap-3 overflow-y-auto pr-2

card.structure: Draggable absolute component. Width 280px. Backdrop blur, solid inner background.
card.frame: 2px solid border mapping to faction color. Soft inner and outer glow based on faction color.
card.header: Top-left: Character name (Cormorant Garamond). Top-right: Action icons (duplicate, scale, edit, rotate, delete) using subtle hover effects.
card.image: Central character image, 16:9 or square cropped, subtle sepia or dark overlay.
card.body: Numeric parameters grid (Armor, Stamina, Melee, Ranged, Attacks/Defenses, Focus). Uses +/- steppers.
card.death_state: If Stamina reaches 0, apply grayscale filter and drop opacity.

main_menu.style: Glassmorphism panel (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) with 1px border-white/10. Vertical list of distinct buttons.
main_menu.buttons: Hover translates slightly right (translate-x-1), text color brightens. Include icons for 'Crear carta', 'Biblioteca', 'Guardar', 'Cargar', etc.

dice_roller.style: Neumorphic/Tactile dark containers. Three distinct sections: Attack, Initiative, Action.
dice_roller.controls: Quantity selectors (numeric input or +/-). Large 'Roll' button with deep red or brass accent.

roll_history_square.style: Uses 'wooden_dice_square' as background-image. Size: 48px by 48px (enlarged for latest roll).
roll_history_square.text: Centered number, bold Alegreya Sans, color mapped to dice logic (Green/Red/Purple/Neutral) with heavy text-shadow for readability.

motion_and_interactions.dice_roll: Shake animation on button click. Small particle burst or flash when result appears.
motion_and_interactions.card_drag: Scale up slightly (scale-105) and increase shadow while dragging. Snap back on drop.
motion_and_interactions.roll_history_entry: Slide in from the right (translate-x-full to 0) with slight bounce.

board_background.description: Dark fantasy tabletop game board background, obsidian table surface, scattered parchment edges, cinematic.

wooden_dice_square.description: High quality dark fantasy wooden square block for roll history backgrounds.

character_portrait_placeholder_1.description: Fantasy portrait featuring a person with gold horns and striking makeup.

character_portrait_placeholder_2.description: Portrait of a mystical character with green hair and elf ears.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use react-draggable for the character cards inside the main board area.
Implement the 5 faction colors explicitly as border and shadow colors for the cards.

Build the wooden square for roll history by setting the 'wooden_dice_square' image as a background with 'bg-cover bg-center' on a div, then place the roll text inside with appropriate dice roll color and heavy text-shadow.
Use standard Lucide React icons for all UI elements like Edit, Delete, Rotate, etc.
Ensure background transparency/opacity is handled carefully so this can look good as an OBS overlay (use dark translucent glassmorphism).
Keep 'Cormorant Garamond' strictly for headers/names and 'Alegreya Sans' for numbers/UI text.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for robust testing.
